variables.name: HINDSIGHT_API_URL
variables.title: Hindsight Base URL
variables.description: Base URL of your self-hosted Hindsight API server (for example, http://localhost:8888). Required; no default.

variables.name: HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID
variables.title: Hindsight Bank ID
variables.description: Target Hindsight memory bank ID for recall and retain operations (for example, my-memory-bank). Required; no default.
